RECENT DEVELOPMENTS LIQUIDS PIPELINES INVESTMENT Mainline System Capital Investment In 2025, we announced plans to invest up to US$1.3 billion in our Mainline System through 2028. These investments are expected to earn a return through the Mainline Tolling Settlement and will be focused on extending the service life of the underlying assets, as well as further enhancing reliability and efficiency given continuing demands on the system. NONCONTROLLING INTEREST INVESTMENT BC Pipeline System On July 2, 2025, Stonlasec8 Indigenous Investments Limited Partnership (the First Nations Partnership), an entity representing 38 First Nations in British Columbia (BC), invested approximately $736 million in our Westcoast Energy Inc. BC natural gas pipeline system. As at December 31, 2025, we own 87.53% of the BC Pipeline system, which is included in our Gas Transmission segment, and continue to manage and operate the pipeline system. The First Nations Partnership owns the remaining 12.47% interest. GAS TRANSMISSION RATE PROCEEDINGS Algonquin Algonquin Gas Transmission, LLC (Algonquin) filed a rate case on May 30, 2024 and a settlement in principle was reached with customers in December 2024. A Stipulation and Agreement was approved by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) on April 25, 2025 with rates effective December 1, 2024. Maritimes & Northeast Maritimes & Northeast (M&N) United States (US) filed a rate case on May 30, 2024 and a settlement in principle was reached with customers in December 2024. A Stipulation and Agreement was approved by the FERC on April 25, 2025 with rates effective January 1, 2025. The toll settlement agreement for M&N Canada expired in December 2025. M&N Canada reached a toll settlement with shippers for the effective period from January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2027. On December 15, 2025, M&N Canada filed the 2026–2027 toll settlement agreement with the Canada Energy Regulator (CER) for review and approval. A CER decision is expected in the first quarter of 2026. 63 East Tennessee East Tennessee Natural Gas, LLC (East Tennessee) filed a rate case on April 29, 2025. On May 29, 2025, the FERC issued an order accepting and suspending tariff records, subject to refund, conditions, and establishing hearing procedures. In compliance with the order, East Tennessee made a filing to implement the rates to be effective November 1, 2025, subject to refund. Settlement discussions with shippers commenced in the third quarter of 2025. Vector Vector Pipeline L.P. (Vector) filed a rate case on May 30, 2025. On June 30, 2025, the FERC issued an order accepting and suspending tariff records filed in this rate case, and establishing hearing procedures. In compliance with the order, Vector placed the proposed rates into effect on July 1, 2025. Additionally, on July 1, 2025, the chief administrative law judge issued an order consolidating Vector’s outstanding review of rates initiated by the FERC in 2024 with Vector’s May 30, 2025 rate case filing. credit_strengths.text: Operating margin is well above the sector median, reflecting the contracted, toll-based economics of the liquids and gas transmission systems, where revenue is largely insulated from commodity price swings and supports predictable cash generation through the cycle.

Operating cash flow comfortably covers the common dividend, and no buybacks were executed, so distributions are funded from internally generated cash rather than incremental borrowing, which preserves the asset base and limits reliance on external capital markets.

key_risks.text: Gross leverage sits far above the sector median and the indicative financial risk profile is highly leveraged, so the capital structure leaves limited cushion if EBITDA softens or if the Mainline System investment programme runs over budget.

The debt note shows a large block of US dollar senior notes maturing across the coming decades and meaningful current maturities, so refinancing depends on continued access to investment-grade markets at acceptable spreads; a funding disruption would pressure liquidity.

Rate proceedings at Algonquin, East Tennessee and Vector remain subject to refund and settlement, and the M&N Canada toll settlement awaits regulatory approval, so adverse outcomes could compress transmission revenue and weaken debt-service headroom.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is roughly a third of the sector median and EBITDA coverage is similarly thin, so a modest rise in borrowing costs or a dip in operating income would erode the already narrow cushion over interest obligations.

Free cash flow after capital spending falls short of the dividend, and free cash flow to debt is far below the sector median, so the distribution is partly funded by balance-sheet capacity rather than internally generated surplus.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer is a large, toll-based pipeline operator with strong margins and stable operating cash flow, but leverage is well above the sector median and the indicative risk profile is highly leveraged, so the credit view is cautious despite the resilient business model.

Leverage improved modestly year over year and the current ratio rose, yet the current ratio remains below the sector median and below one, so near-term liquidity is thin and refinancing of current maturities will be a recurring funding task for management.

credit_strengths.text: 營運利潤率遠高於行業中位數，反映液體及氣體輸送系統以合約為本、基於通行費的經濟模式；在該模式下，收入在很大程度上不受商品價格波動影響，並支撐整個週期內可預測的現金產生。
營運現金流足以輕鬆覆蓋普通股股息，且並未執行任何回購，因此分派乃由內部產生的現金而非增量借貸提供資金，這保留了資產基礎並限制了對外部資本市場的依賴。

key_risks.text: 總槓桿率遠高於行業中位數，且指示性財務風險狀況為高度槓桿，因此若 EBITDA 轉弱或 Mainline System 投資計劃超出預算，資本結構留下的緩衝有限。
債務附註顯示，有一大筆美元優先票據將於未來數十年內到期，另有金額可觀的流動到期債務，因此再融資取決於能否繼續以可接受的息差進入投資級市場；融資中斷將對流動性構成壓力。
Algonquin、East Tennessee 及 Vector 的費率程序仍可能涉及退款與和解，而 M&N Canada 的通行費和解尚待監管批准，因此不利結果可能壓縮輸送收入並削弱償債餘裕。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率約為行業中位數的三分之一，EBITDA 覆蓋率同樣偏薄，因此借貸成本小幅上升或營運收入下滑，都將侵蝕本已狹窄的利息義務緩衝。
資本開支後的自由現金流不足以覆蓋股息，且自由現金流對債務比率遠低於行業中位數，因此分派部分由資產負債表能力而非內部產生的盈餘提供資金。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人是一家大型、基於通行費的管道營運商，利潤率強勁且營運現金流穩定，但槓桿率遠高於行業中位數，且指示性風險狀況為高度槓桿，因此儘管業務模式具韌性，信貸觀點仍屬審慎。
槓桿率按年溫和改善，流動比率亦上升，但流動比率仍低於行業中位數且低於一，因此短期流動性偏薄，流動到期債務的再融資將是管理層反覆面對的融資任務。
